Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks to keep momentum: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary use case: product search relevance & merchandising personalization across web and mobile.
- Key constraints: <10% latency impact at tail, data residency in US, SOC2/compliance for PII.
- Decision criteria: latency SLA, total cost of ownership, quality/regression risk during model swaps.

Immediate next steps we agreed on:
1) Stakeholder map — can you share the org chart / who owns economics (budget holder), security, legal, and procurement?
2) Technical attachment — I will send a short security summary and mutual action plan (MAP) for your review; happy to tailor.
3) Intro to procurement/econ buyer — if you can loop them in, we’ll prepare a short procurement checklist and SOW template.

Attachments planned: MAP_v1.pdf, redwood-security-summary.pdf (will follow in separate email).

If easier, a one-line intro to the buyer (name + role + email) and the security contact is perfect. Ill coordinate a short 30-min follow-up with the broader list.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for the clear asks. Quick answers below and I've attached our current org chart (ACME_OrgChart_v2.pdf) — it's high level but shows the owners for product, data, security and procurement.

Who to loop in:
- Economic buyer (budget owner): Carlos Mendez, VP Product (carlos.mendez@acme-commerce.com) — he owns tooling spend for search/commerce.
- Security lead: Priya Natarajan (pri...@acme-commerce.com) — she owns vendor security reviews and SOC2 sign-offs.
- Procurement: Tom Fischer (tom.fischer@acme-commerce.com) — handles contracts and SOWs.

Procurement process (short):
1) Procurement asks for commercial terms + SOW + security artifacts (SOC2 report, data flow).
2) Legal does a light T&C review; redlines usually handled by procurement.
3) Procurement signs off with PO or contract depending on spend threshold (>$75k requires legal approval).

Happy to intro you to Carlos and Tom — would you like an intro thread that includes the MAP and a short note on decision criteria? For security, Priya prefers we share vendor security docs first (SOC2 + security summary) before a call.

Attached: ACME_OrgChart_v2.pdf

Best,
Elena
Sr. Product Manager, Personalization | Acme Commerce
